gloss: point in time, as of (a certain time)

definitions.gloss: point in time, as of (a certain time)
definitions.explanation: A specific moment or point on a timeline. Used to indicate when something was true or when a decision was made, often emphasizing that the situation may have changed since then.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{時点|じてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}からなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: At that point in time, I didn't know.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現時点|げんじてん}→現時点：13556_genjiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧です。
examples.english: As of now, it is undecided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦{締結|ていけつ}→締結：13870_teiketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時点|じてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{双方|そうほう}→双方：11859_souhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同意|どうい}していた→同意する：06056_douisuru⟧。
examples.english: At the time the contract was signed, both parties had agreed to these conditions.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in formal and semi-formal contexts. The most frequent patterns are:
- Noun + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時点|じてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at the time/point of [noun]
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{時点|じてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at that point
- ⟦{現時点|げんじてん}→現時点：13556_genjiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at the present time, as of now
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{時点|じてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at this point

Implies that the situation described may no longer be true — it captures a snapshot of a specific moment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{現時点|げんじてん}→現時点：13556_genjiten⟧: the current point in time
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{時点|じてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: at that point
- …⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時点|じてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: as of …, at the time of …

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧: stage, phase (sequential progression)
- ⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧: moment, instant (very brief)
- ⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: time, period (broader duration)
